headline: Alstom shares sink up to 28% after cutting adjusted EBIT margin guidance to 1%
summary: Alstom cut its adjusted EBIT margin outlook to about 1% from 6.5% previously, citing execution issues with Coradia Max, triggering a share slide of up to 28% and prompting an overhaul plan.
why: Alstom is one of the world's largest rolling stock and rail infrastructure manufacturers, making execution challenges and profit warnings closely watched across European industrials.

impacts.name: Alstom SA
impacts.why: Alstom sharply lowered its fiscal year adjusted EBIT margin forecast to approximately 1% from 6.5%.
